content: {"rule":"K-S2","applies":"yes","applies_why":"The judge text uses the open sense of the single verse Isaiah 7:14 as the ground for UNDERDETERMINED, which is the situation K-S2 governs.","verdict":"BREACH","quote":"D5 vs C5 (Isaiah 7:14): UNDERDETERMINED -- [CR2] G answers the 'almah/bethulah and near-fulfillment rows, leaving the sign's sense open.","rule_words":"That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side.
